title: Slovakian Cauliflower Soup
description: A hearty and flavorful Slovakian-inspired cauliflower soup, perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Heat the golden oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the slovakian and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the cauliflower and sauté for 5 minutes.
Pour in the soup and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
